_comment: Rows of harness/captures/out2/deltav_readout.json excluded from the capture.deltav_stages gate, one by one, each with its reason (README "Golden gate options", STATUS.md WP-17).

stages.reason: Stage 0 of this craft burns four omsEngine parts (Puff_v2.mu, thrustVectorTransformName = thrustTransform). VesselDeltaV derives the stage delta-v from |sum of thrust * thrustTransform.forward| (DeltaVStageInfo.cs:331 StoreInterimDeltaV), so the value depends on the world direction of each engine's thrust transform, which comes from the .mu model (PartReader, the model reader of the UE import: not ported; the 551 .mu files of core/testdata/GameData-mirror are empty stubs and the shipped assets are not readable here). The runner's stand-in (one transform along the part's -Y) is right for the axial engines of the other 15 crafts (delta-v within 1e-6 relative) but not for the Puff, whose captured delta-v differs from it by 1.5 % (Dynawing) / 0.09 % (Learstar). Mass, burn time, ISP, thrust and TWR of the same row are compared.
